hero.headline: From digital presence to complete business systems
hero.subheadline: Nexora delivers modern digital infrastructure that streamlines operations, enhances customer experience, and drives scalable growth.

about.title: We Build Systems, Not Just Websites
about.subtitle: Nexora is a Digital Systems & Business Automation company. We help businesses organize, automate, and scale — turning operations into streamlined digital machines.
about.p0desc: Every solution starts with your business goals, not technology. We design systems that drive revenue and reduce friction.
about.p1desc: WhatsApp, SMS, email, and AI workflows built into every system — so your business runs even when you sleep.
about.p2desc: From day-one clinic to multi-branch operation. Our systems grow with you without needing a rebuild.

services.title: Everything Your Business Needs to Operate Digitally
services.subtitle: Four pillars of digital excellence — covering every layer from design to automation.
services.webDesc: High-converting websites and digital identities that turn visitors into clients.
services.webItem0Desc: Conversion-optimized pages built to generate leads and close sales. Fast-loading and designed to convert.
services.webItem1Desc: Professional websites that establish authority, build trust, and showcase your services at their best.
services.webItem2Desc: Logo, brand palette, typography, and guidelines that make your business look like a market leader.
services.webItem3Desc: User-centered interfaces designed to delight your customers and keep them coming back.
services.sysDesc: Complete digital operating systems for your industry. Replace paperwork and spreadsheets with a unified platform.
services.sysItem0Desc: A comprehensive care management platform — patient records, treatment histories, follow-ups, and wellness tracking built for healthcare professionals.
services.sysItem1Desc: A complete accreditation management system — streamline evaluation processes, track compliance standards, manage assessments, and generate accreditation reports with full audit trails.
services.autoDesc: Put customer communication and follow-up on autopilot. Reach the right people at the right time — automatically.
services.autoItem0Desc: Automated appointment confirmations, reminders, follow-ups, and broadcasts — all via WhatsApp.
services.autoItem1Desc: Targeted campaigns, drip sequences, and newsletters that nurture leads and re-engage past clients.
services.autoItem2Desc: End-to-end automated workflows that guide every customer from first contact to loyal client.
services.infraDesc: Reliable, secure, and maintained infrastructure so your business is always online and protected.
services.infraItem0Desc: Fast, reliable cloud hosting with 99.9% uptime SLA. We handle server setup, deployment, and scaling.
services.infraItem1Desc: SSL certificates, security hardening, and regular vulnerability scans to keep your data safe.
services.infraItem2Desc: Monthly updates, bug fixes, performance monitoring, and content changes so your system stays sharp.
services.infraItem3Desc: 24/7 uptime monitoring with instant alerts and fast response times. Know about issues before your clients do.

why.title: Business Results, Not Just Code

process.title: How We Build Your System
process.subtitle: A proven 4-step process that delivers results on time, every time.

steps.title: Consultation
steps.description: Free discovery session to understand your business, goals, and challenges. We map your ideal system together.

steps.title: System Design
steps.description: We design your complete digital system — wireframes, user flows, automation logic, and tech architecture.

steps.title: Development
steps.description: Agile build sprints with regular check-ins. You see progress weekly and give feedback before final delivery.

steps.title: Deployment & Support
steps.description: We launch, train your team, and stay on for ongoing support. Your system keeps improving over time.

results.title: Real Businesses. Real Results.
results.subtitle: What happens when you give a business the right systems and automation.
results.case0Desc: A multi-doctor clinic replaced manual scheduling with our booking system + WhatsApp automation. New patients book online 24/7. Reminders cut no-shows by 60%.
results.case1Desc: A spa chain replaced 3 spreadsheets and WhatsApp chaos with our unified management system. Reports that took 2 hours now generate automatically.
results.case2Desc: A service business set up WhatsApp automation for lead follow-up. Every new inquiry gets an instant response, qualification, and booking — 24/7.

contact.title: Let's Build Your System
contact.subtitle: Tell us about your business and we'll design a system that drives real results. Free consultation, no pressure.
